source.reconstruction_note: The original generated case file was absent from the report archive. These eight approved case titles, prompts, and iteration-one corrections were reconstructed from the human-readable report.

cases.source_case: Positive 1 - Run Physics Agent on a USD and classify components
cases.prompt: Run the local Physics Agent CLI on the public lightbulb asset, classify its components and physical properties, and report the predictions and authored physics USD.

expected.description: Activates the repo environment, inspects the public config and input path, verifies provider and endpoint prerequisites, dry-runs, then uses physics-agent run without backgrounding the process.
Waits for terminal completion and verifies predictions, restored predictions when applicable, and an authored physics USD before reporting success.

prerequisites: The repo environment is active and physics-agent is installed.
The selected VLM provider credential is configured.
The rendering endpoint and any enabled optimizer endpoint are reachable.
side_effects: Creates a case-specific Physics Agent working directory and output artifacts.
Submits VLM, rendering, and optional optimizer requests configured by the fixture.
cleanup: Remove the case-specific working directory after evidence is captured.
Stop only processes started by this case and preserve shared endpoints.

cases.prompt: Make the provided instanced USD simulation-ready with the local Physics Agent CLI. Handle instance proxies safely, author rigid-body and collision schemas, and verify the resulting USD.

expected.description: Detects the fixture's instanceable prims, prepares a copied config with optimize_usd and deinstance enabled, keeps restore_usd behavior clear, and dry-runs before execution.
Waits for completion and inspects the output USD for authored physics schemas rather than treating optimizer success alone as completion.

prerequisites: The Physics Agent CLI and repo environment are available.
The configured VLM, rendering, and scene optimizer dependencies are healthy.
The evaluator can inspect USD schema metadata in the produced artifact.
side_effects: Creates a copied config, optimized USD, predictions, and authored physics USD in a case-specific directory.
Submits requests to configured VLM, rendering, and optimizer services.
cleanup: Remove only case-specific configs and outputs.
Stop only processes launched by the case and leave shared services running.

cases.source_case: Positive 3 - Debug PhysicsAuthoringError on an instance proxy
cases.prompt: Physics Agent failed with PhysicsAuthoringError because a prediction targets an instance proxy. Diagnose the failure and give the safest corrected CLI and config approach.

expected.description: Explains that instance proxies are not writable, recommends optimize_usd with deinstance before apply_physics, preserves raw prediction paths for the optimized stage, and does not suggest suppressing the authoring error.

cases.source_case: Positive 4 - Tune authored physics so the asset settles
cases.prompt: Use the local Physics Agent tuning workflow to tune the public tire physics so it settles according to the drop-settle scenario. Use production simulation evidence and report the best parameters and tuned USD.

expected.description: Requires a physics-authored USD, selects a production simulator rather than fake, uses a bounded trial count and output directory, and does not claim a long-running tune completed.
Waits for the production simulator run to finish and verifies best-parameter metadata, scores, and a tuned USD before reporting success.

prerequisites: A physics-authored tire USD has been produced from the public classification config.
A supported production simulation backend and its tuning dependencies are installed.
The evaluator has sufficient GPU and runtime capacity for the bounded tune.
side_effects: Runs multiple bounded simulation trials and writes trial artifacts.
Creates best-parameter metadata, score evidence, and a tuned physics USD.
cleanup: Terminate the case-owned simulator process on completion or timeout.
Remove case-specific trial and output directories after preserving required evidence.

cases.source_case: Negative 1 - Make a Physics Agent REST service request
cases.prompt: Upload this USD to the Physics Agent REST API, watch its service session, and download the output.

expected.description: Routes to physics-agent-client and does not substitute local CLI execution for the requested service workflow.

cases.source_case: Negative 2 - Deploy Physics Agent with Docker or Brev
cases.prompt: Deploy the Physics Agent service, choosing either local Docker or a hosted GPU instance.

expected.description: Names deploy-physics-agent-docker and deploy-physics-agent-brev as the relevant choices and performs no deployment mutation.

cases.source_case: Negative 3 - Apply visual materials and produce a beauty render
cases.prompt: Assign realistic PBR materials to this USD and produce a final beauty render with the local agent CLI.

expected.description: Routes visual material assignment to material-agent-cli and explains that Physics Agent authors physics, not final PBR appearance.

cases.prompt: What is the difference between a rigid body and a collider?

expected.description: Answers the conceptual question directly without running Physics Agent or fabricating asset-specific results.
